mapper.sql: id, card_id AS cardId, role_id AS roleId, episode_no AS episodeNo, title, created_at AS createdAt
mapper.select: SELECT rc.id, rc.card_id AS cardId, rc.role_id AS roleId, rc.episode_no AS episodeNo, rc.title, rc.created_at AS createdAt, r.name AS roleName FROM card_rc rc LEFT JOIN role r ON r.id = rc.role_id WHERE rc.card_id = #{cardId} ORDER BY rc.episode_no, rc.id

SELECT rc.id, rc.card_id AS cardId, rc.role_id AS roleId, rc.episode_no AS episodeNo, rc.title, rc.created_at AS createdAt, r.name AS roleName FROM card_rc rc LEFT JOIN role r ON r.id = rc.role_id WHERE rc.id = #{id}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO card_rc (card_id, role_id, episode_no, title) VALUES (#{cardId}, #{roleId}, #{episodeNo}, #{title})
